name: Minecraft
description: Voxel sandbox with keyboard movement and a mouse-look camera.

vision.prompt: Describe the Minecraft scene: what is in front of the player, what the hotbar and health show, and whether anything is dangerous.

notes: Look before you walk. Movement is a bounded key hold, so long walks need several game_move calls. With control.mode "auto", a Minecraft integration connected through the relay takes over input and Neuro Desktop only observes.
